audit.why: 48.91% over 914 games supports EVEN 5.5/10. Levels 1-2 are yours before the fear proc exists; 3-5 evens out; level 6 is hers because Shadow Surge is a 2000-range dash execute that resets on a kill.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0].side and phases[1].side read 'Skill' against win[0]/win[1] 'Orianna', and phases[4].side read 'Skill' against win[4] 'Vex'. Three cross-layer disagreements; every why was Orianna boilerplate calling Vex 'he'.
audit.why: The packet levelChart matches the content layer on all three rows.
audit.corrected: Sides moved to Orianna, Orianna and Vex with ratings recurved and all six flagged whys rewritten from the kits.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page calls the fear 'Personal Space (Fear)' throughout. Personal Space is Vex's W and Riot's text for it is only 'Gain a shield and damage nearby enemies' — the fear belongs to her passive, Doom 'n Gloom, which empowers her next basic ability to fear and interrupt dashes.
audit.why: Attributing the fear to the wrong slot sends the reader watching the wrong cooldown: the W is a 16s shield, while the fear is a passive charge with no fixed timer you can count.
audit.corrected: focus.text, enemyWin, winCon and breakdown.cooldowns now name Doom 'n Gloom as the fear and Personal Space as the shield.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page told the reader that Doom 'n Gloom interrupts dashes — the single most important thing an Orianna needs to know before shielding a diving jungler in.
audit.why: Riot's passive text: her next basic ability fears enemies and interrupts dashes, and any nearby enemy dash marks itself for bonus damage and refunds her passive cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: 27 fields misgendered Vex as he/his/him, plus the two trade-line bleeds under unrelated Do's/Don'ts titles.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed across the fields proposed; both bleed bullets replaced with kit-grounded text matching their titles.
